messages:
Devin: Uploaded new mocks for the *Batch Vectors + Rerank* flow — preview + export flows. https://app.redwood.design/s/vec-batch-rerank (pngs + figma comments).
Alex: Nice — first glance: the relevance table feels dense. can we drop to 12px body, 14px header? feels like whitespace is enough. :thinking_face:
Maria: Agree on density. Also keyboard nav: when tabbing through header sort buttons they need clear focus rings and aria labels. e.g., `aria-label=\"Sort by relevance score\"` + `role=\"button\"`.
Sam: For export, we should include both raw similarity score and the rerank score + original index. customers want reproducibility. CSV header example: `id,original_index,similarity_score,rerank_score,source_text`.
Olivia: Accessibility nit: the red/yellow heatmap scale at small sizes fails contrast with body text. current stop colors: `#ffb3b3` and `#ffd580` — need darker endpoints, maybe `#e04545` and `#b37a00`. Also add pattern/fill for colorblind users.
design-bot: Automated a11y scan: table headers missing `scope` attribute and `aria-sort` toggles not announced. Suggest `scope=\"col\"` + update `aria-sort` on toggle.
Devin: Good catches. On copy: should button read \"Export results\" or \"Download CSV\"? I lean toward \"Export results\" for clarity since we offer JSON and CSV.
Alex: If we have multiple formats, primary CTA = \"Export results\" and secondary = \"Download CSV\" (under more/export options). keeps header clean.
Maria: Modal behavior: when export starts there's a progress bar. use determinate progress when we know batch size. avoid an infinite spinner for exports >5s. Also add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` announcement when finished.
Sam: Rerank controls: current slider says \"weight\" but unclear if it's multiplicative or additive. add microcopy: \"Weight multiplies similarity score before combining with model score\" and a preview toggle that shows top-5 before/after.
Olivia: Preview table keyboard quick actions: allow `k`/`j` to move rows (vim-y), and `space` to pin a row. also ensure pinned rows have `aria-pressed` state.
Devin: Export payload should include the rerank params (seed, top_k, weight) in a metadata JSON block at top of file for easier audit. also timestamp and model variant.
Alex: On pagination vs virtual scroll: for very large batches (>50k) virtual scroll + skeletons will kill export UX. recommend explicit \"Prepare export\" step that runs in background and not rely purely on client memory.
Sam: Are we storing logs/metrics for cost estimation? Suggest telemetry: tokens processed, avg seq len, estimated cost per export. show small cost hint next to Export CTA.
design-bot: Small lint: button label truncated on mobile. max-width 120px for primary CTA is too small.
Olivia: Contrast test on mobile: table zebra stripes lose effect at 12px, prefer border-bottom on rows at `1px solid #e6e8eb`.
Devin: I'll update figma with changed colors, add aria attributes, and add a small metadata block to the export modal. Will push a new iteration by EOD.
deploy-bot: FYI — new assets will trigger a design-assets build in the pipeline when pushed.
Alex: Thanks — can someone add a short acceptance checklist in the figma comments? accessibility checks + export metadata + determinacy of progress.
Maria: I'll add the keyboard focus walkthrough and do a quick screenreader pass tomorrow.
Devin: Awesome. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
